spec.title: Active Watch Requests
spec.description: Long-running (watch) requests currently held open against the API server. A steady climb can indicate a watch leak in a controller or client.

spec.title: APF Executing Requests by Priority
spec.description: Current requests executing under API Priority and Fairness.

spec.title: APF Queued
spec.description: Current requests pending in API Priority and Fairness queues.

spec.title: APF Queued Requests by Priority
spec.description: Current requests pending in API Priority and Fairness queues.

spec.title: APF Rejected Requests
spec.description: API Priority and Fairness rejected requests. Nonzero values indicate overload or queue shedding.

spec.title: API 429 (5m)
spec.description: HTTP 429 responses in the last 5 minutes. 429 indicates API priority and fairness throttling or overload.

spec.title: API 5xx (5m)
spec.description: API server responses with 5xx status codes in the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: API Inflight Requests by Kind
spec.description: Current API requests actively being handled, split by read-only and mutating requests.

spec.title: API Request Latency p99 by Verb
spec.description: 99th percentile API request latency by verb. Long-running WATCH requests are excluded.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le, verb) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster",subresource="",verb!="WATCH"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster, verb) sum by (cluster, verb) (rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster",subresource="",verb!="WATCH"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

spec.title: API Storage Errors
spec.description: Storage decode and data key generation errors. Nonzero values deserve investigation.

spec.title: Container Waiting Reasons
spec.description: Containers currently waiting, grouped by reason. Empty is good: the reason label only exists while a container is waiting, so an empty table means every container is past that state.

spec.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster",namespace=~"$namespace"} == 1)

spec.title: Cordoned Nodes
spec.description: Nodes marked unschedulable.

spec.title: Cordoned Nodes (Current)
spec.description: Nodes marked unschedulable.

spec.title: CoreDNS Forward Failures (5m)
spec.description: Upstream DNS forwarder healthcheck failures in the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: CoreDNS Panics (1h)
spec.description: CoreDNS process panics in the last hour.

spec.title: CoreDNS Reload Failures (1h)
spec.description: CoreDNS reload failures in the last hour.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, le, proxy_name, to) (rate(coredns_proxy_request_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: CPU Requested vs Allocatable
spec.description: Total CPU requests as a percentage of cluster allocatable CPU.

spec.title: DNS SERVFAIL (5m)
spec.description: CoreDNS SERVFAIL responses in the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: etcd Object Count by Resource (Top 20)
spec.description: Number of objects stored in etcd/kine per resource type. Helps spot unexpected growth that bloats the backend.

spec.title: etcd Request Errors
spec.description: Errors returned by the etcd/kine backend. Nonzero values deserve investigation.

spec.title: etcd Request Latency p99 by Operation
spec.description: 99th percentile latency of API server requests to the etcd/kine backend, by operation. The backend is the usual root cause of control-plane slowness.

spec.title: etcd Request Rate by Operation
spec.description: Rate of API server requests to the etcd/kine backend, by operation.

spec.title: Failed Jobs
spec.description: Jobs with one or more failed pods. Empty is good, and stays empty while the cluster runs no Jobs at all -- kube_job_* series exist only per Job object.

spec.title: Failed Jobs (Current)
spec.description: Jobs with failed pods in the selected namespaces.

spec.title: Memory Requested vs Allocatable
spec.description: Total memory requests as a percentage of cluster allocatable memory.

spec.title: Node Pressure Conditions
spec.description: Nodes currently reporting MemoryPressure, DiskPressure, PIDPressure, or NetworkUnavailable.

spec.title: Pending Pods by Queue
spec.description: Pods waiting to be scheduled, split by scheduler queue (active, backoff, unschedulable, gated). A sustained backlog signals scheduling problems.

spec.title: Pods Used vs Allocatable
spec.description: Running pods as a percentage of cluster allocatable pod capacity.

spec.title: PV Not Bound
spec.description: PersistentVolumes not in the Bound phase.

spec.title: Scheduling Attempt Latency p99
spec.description: 99th percentile end-to-end scheduling attempt duration.

spec.title: Scheduling Attempts by Result
spec.description: Rate of pod scheduling attempts by outcome. 'unschedulable' or 'error' indicate the scheduler cannot place pods.

spec.title: Unschedulable Pods
spec.description: Pods currently marked unschedulable.

spec.title: Unschedulable Pods by Namespace
spec.description: Pods currently marked unschedulable, grouped by namespace. Empty is good: kube-state-metrics only emits this series while a pod is actually unschedulable, so nothing to show means nothing is stuck.

spec.title: Workqueue Depth
spec.description: Total controller-manager workqueue depth. A sustained rise means controllers are falling behind on reconciliation.

spec.title: Workqueue Retries
spec.description: Rate of workqueue item retries. Elevated retries indicate controllers repeatedly failing to reconcile.

spec.title: Workqueue Work Duration p99
spec.description: 99th percentile time controllers spend processing a single workqueue item.
